claims.harness: Isolated --init-only, credential-less print, and loopback API-error print lanes (init, headless, api-error-<status>) recorded by an HTTP hook sink in the adapter hook shape, in packages/surface/vendors/claude/census/harness.mjs
claims.notes: headless ran in the census network-deny sandbox (packages/surface/vendors/claude/census/sandbox.mjs; captures sandbox.json): a fresh user, network and mount namespace whose only interface was loopback, every public and caller-proxy destination refused and the artifact's well-known credential directory empty before the artifact ran, and no non-loopback attempt recorded. A sandboxed run writes sandbox.json for every mode it captures, so headless came from a separate census run from the claim's other modes; capturedAt dates one run only, and the capture set's SANITIZATION.md dates each.

claims.harness: Native TUI in a harness-owned PTY against a scripted loopback Messages API, then --resume by id (interactive, resume), in packages/surface/vendors/claude/census/interactive-lane.mjs

Exact artifact --version and --help in a disposable environment, SHA-256, and bounded static probes of the subagent status channel and hook-event inventory in packages/surface/vendors/claude/census/generate-model.mjs; reviewed invocation-grammar and hook-switch probe records beside them

claims.notes: Digest-pinned review of https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks retrieved for the v2.1.311 adaptation and reconciled with the executable's bundled hook schemas. Documentation proves declared support, not execution on the pinned artifact.

limitations: Artifact integrity and controlled runtime captures currently cover only linux-x64; protected promotion still requires every configured platform.

No committed lane sends a model anything but the placeholder ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN: the API-error and interactive lanes talk to a census loopback model, and the init and credential-less print lanes set no token (a credential-less print lane is committed only where it made no model request). Print lanes reach the API-error path through a loopback Messages API; the interactive lane drives the native TUI against a scripted loopback model, so assistant text, tool choices, compaction summaries, and model-switch pricing inputs are synthetic while hook shapes, transports, and order are native.

Not reached by any lane: Setup outside --init-only, UserPromptExpansion, PermissionDenied (auto mode), TaskCreated, TaskCompleted, TeammateIdle, WorktreeCreate, WorktreeRemove, Elicitation, ElicitationResult, PostModelSwitch outside a /model switch, mcp_server on MCP tool events, scratchpad_dir, and PostToolUse(Bash) tool_response.bashEditDiff.
The official hook reference is mutable. Its reviewed summary is digest-pinned here, and a future candidate must repeat the review and census rather than inheriting this claim.

Only headless ran in the network-deny sandbox. api-error-400, api-error-401, api-error-429, api-error-500, api-error-529, init, interactive, resume ran without it: their model traffic named a census loopback endpoint, but non-loopback egress was not structurally denied for them, and no egress claim covers them (findings.md records what was observed).
